subject: reading wallace models back into R for further analysis or visualization

messages.author: f2da935e89dcb8c8
messages.subject: reading wallace models back into R for further analysis or visualization
parts:
1) Is there a way to import our wallace-produced model back into an R object, to run analyses in other packages (e.g. niche equivalency in ENMTools)?

2) How can we visualize the output .grd/.gri ENMs in R to produce higher resolution figures?

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: reading wallace models back into R for further analysis or visualization
parts:
Hi Jocelyn,

1) This option is not available on Wallace. But, once you get your model on the GUI, you can download a markdown in the Session Code tab. This file allows you to re-run your model in R console in where you can add others analyses.

2) There is plenty information that can help you to visualize raters in R. Maybe some of these links can help you:
https://www.neonscience.org/dc-plot-raster-data-rn
https://rblogzef.wordpress.com/2014/05/12/raster-visualization-with-r/

Best,
Gonzalo
